prompt: Implement parseOptions(args) and add visible tests. Return { verbose, output, files }. Support -v and --verbose, -o PATH and --output PATH, and --output=PATH. Later output options win. Defaults are false, undefined, and an empty list. Preserve positional order, treat a lone dash as positional, and treat all tokens after -- as positional. Throw RangeError for unsupported flags or missing or empty output values. A separate output value may be a lone dash but may not otherwise start with a dash.
